brief:
Gaza's petroleum authority announced the arrival of four trucks carrying cooking gas and the resumption of distribution to 7,166 beneficiaries, Shehab Wire reported. The authority said it would distribute gas according to a registry dated October 30, allocating supplies by kilogram per household.

The announcement clarified the mechanism for distribution, though it did not specify when deliveries would begin or how long supplies would last given Gaza's ongoing fuel crisis.

title: Gaza receives cooking gas shipment after shortage
